products.descriptionShort: BX-151 pressure-energised ring joint gasket for API 6BX flanges 1-13/16″ at 10,000, 15,000 and 20,000 psi. Soft iron, low carbon steel, stainless and alloy.
products.descriptionLong:
The BX-151 is a pressure-energised ring joint gasket for API 6BX flanges. It fits API 6BX flanges 1-13/16″ at 10,000, 15,000 and 20,000 psi. Supplied new in soft iron, low carbon steel, stainless steel or corrosion-resistant alloy.

Flanges it fits

Style BX

BX rings are pressure-energised, made to API 6A for API 6BX flanges, for service up to 20,000 psi. The flange faces make up almost face-to-face, trapping the ring on both its inside and outside diameters, and every BX ring has a pressure-passage hole to equalise pressure trapped in the grooves.
